name: use-hotkeys
title: useHotkeys
description: Keyboard shortcuts such as mod+k or escape, ignored while typing in fields unless allowed.
a11y: No DOM output. Shortcuts are additions: every control must still be reachable by keyboard and Tab.
mod means Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere. Typing in inputs is ignored unless allowInInputs is set.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Set false to turn every binding off. Default true.

props.name: allowInInputs
props.description: Also fire while focus is in a text field, select or contenteditable. Default false.

props.name: preventDefault
props.description: Call `preventDefault` on a matched key. Default true.
